label: Myeloid cells
definition: Monocytes, macrophages, dendritic cells, granulocytes and mast cells.
pdac_evidence: Myeloid and mast cells of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 1A-B)

label: Macrophages
definition: Tissue phagocytes, either self-renewing resident cells or cells derived from recruited monocytes; one of the three ontogeny-based families of mononuclear phagocytes.
signature_ref: zilionis2019 (Fig. 5; S5I-J)
pdac_evidence: Macrophage label of the original myeloid subclustering of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3H-I)

label: Monocytes
definition: Blood-derived mononuclear phagocytes recruited into tissue, where they can become macrophages or monocyte-derived cells.
signature_ref: zilionis2019 (Fig. 5B; S5F-G) and zhang2020 (Fig. S8B)
pdac_evidence: Monocyte label of the original myeloid subclustering of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3H-I)

label: Dendritic cells
definition: Antigen-presenting cells specialised in activating T cells; three main subsets: plasmacytoid DCs and two conventional (myeloid) DC types, cDC1 and cDC2.
signature_ref: collin2018 (Table 1) and zilionis2019 (Fig. 4B/H)
pdac_evidence: Dendritic label of the original myeloid subclustering of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3H-I); whether pDCs are inside this label is not stated

label: Neutrophils
definition: Short-lived granulocytes; under-represented in droplet (10x) single-cell data because of their fragility and low RNA content.
signature_ref: zilionis2019 (Fig. 1E; 2A)
pdac_evidence: Neutrophil label of the original myeloid subclustering of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3H-I); Wang 2023 note that most earlier 10x PDAC studies did not detect neutrophils

label: Mast cells
definition: Granule-containing tissue-resident cells of the myeloid lineage.
signature_ref: zilionis2019 (Fig. 2A)
pdac_evidence: A separate cell type in these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 1); Mast_KIT present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C)

label: C1QC+ macrophages
definition: Macrophages with complement (C1Q) and phagocytosis/antigen-presentation genes.
signature_ref: zhang2020 (Fig. S8B)
pdac_evidence: Present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); not a separate cluster in Caronni 2023, where C1QA/C1QC mark all macrophages (Extended Data Fig. 1d), so it may be hard to separate from macrophages in general

label: SPP1+ macrophages
definition: Tumour-enriched macrophages marked by SPP1; in human PDAC with lipid-metabolism and phagocytosis genes (FBP1, APOC1, MARCO). In colorectal cancer the SPP1+ subset was instead defined by angiogenic genes (VEGFA, EREG; Zhang 2020), a programme that in PDAC sits mainly with IL1B+ macrophages (Caronni 2023).
signature_ref: caronni2023 (Fig. 1a cluster box, human PDAC)
pdac_evidence: SPP1+ TAMs in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 1a) and in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C)

label: Interferon-stimulated macrophages
definition: Macrophages expressing interferon-stimulated genes.
signature_ref: ma2022 (Table 1: IFN-TAMs; subset of the listed signature)
pdac_evidence: Macro_ISG15 is in the pan-cancer study but not in its pancreatic adenocarcinoma map (Cheng 2021 Fig. 6A, S1C)

label: IL1B+ inflammatory macrophages
definition: Monocyte-derived macrophages expressing inflammatory (IL1B, TNF, NLRP3, PTGS2), leukocyte-recruitment (CXCL1, CXCL2, CCL3) and angiogenesis programmes; described in human PDAC.
signature_ref: caronni2023 (Fig. 1a cluster box: IL1B, IL1A, NLRP3, PTGS2, CCL3; Results text: TNF, CXCL1, CXCL2; Fig. 1a heat map: IL6)
pdac_evidence: Defined in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 1a; 10 patients); Macro_IL1B is in the pan-cancer study but not in its pancreatic adenocarcinoma map (Cheng 2021)

label: FOLR2+ resident-like macrophages
definition: Macrophages resembling tissue-resident interstitial macrophages of normal tissue.
signature_ref: caronni2023 (Fig. 1a cluster box: FOLR2, LYVE1, SELENOP, SLC40A1, MRC1; heat map: PLTP); same core as ma2022 Table 1 (interstitial RTM-like)
pdac_evidence: FOLR2+ TAMs in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 1a); Macro_LYVE1 is in the pan-cancer study but not in its pancreatic adenocarcinoma map (Cheng 2021)

label: HSP+ programme
definition: Macrophage state with heat-shock genes; described in human PDAC.
signature_ref: caronni2023 (Fig. 1a cluster box)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 1a)

label: MT+ programme
definition: Macrophage state with metallothionein genes; described in human PDAC.
signature_ref: caronni2023 (Fig. 1a cluster box)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 1a)

label: Monocyte-like programme
definition: Classical-monocyte genes (FCN1, S100A8/9, VCAN) in cells of the macrophage lineage: monocytes in transition to macrophages.
signature_ref: classical-monocyte genes from zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM05) and caronni2023 (Extended Data Fig. 1d: VCAN); LYZ from villani2017 (Fig. 1C)
pdac_evidence: Tumour-infiltrating monocytes and their transition to IL1B+ macrophages in human and mouse PDAC (Caronni 2023 Fig. 2)
also_known_as: FCN1+ monocyte-like cells (zhang2020, hM11); tumour-infiltrating monocytes (ma2022, Box 1)

label: Classical (CD14+) monocytes
definition: Monocytes with high CD14 and no CD16 (FCGR3A); the majority of blood monocytes and the usual monocytes in tumours.
signature_ref: zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM05); VCAN from caronni2023 (Extended Data Fig. 1d)
pdac_evidence: Mono_CD14 in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); classical monocytes in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Extended Data Fig. 1c-d: VCAN, S100A8)

label: Non-classical (CD16+) monocytes
definition: Monocytes with low CD14 and high CD16 (FCGR3A).
signature_ref: zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM06; FCN1 and FCGR3B left out because they mark classical monocytes and neutrophils); LST1, IFITM2 from caronni2023 (Extended Data Fig. 1d)
pdac_evidence: Non-classical monocytes in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Extended Data Fig. 1c-d: LST1, IFITM2); not in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C)

label: cDC1
definition: Conventional type 1 dendritic cells (CD141+); specialised in cross-presentation to CD8 T cells.
signature_ref: collin2018 (Table 1); zilionis2019 (Fig. 4B/H); zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM04)
pdac_evidence: cDC1_CLEC9A present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Extended Data Fig. 1c-d: XCR1, CLEC9A, BATF3)

label: cDC2
definition: Conventional type 2 dendritic cells (CD1c+).
signature_ref: collin2018 (Table 1); heger2018; zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM03)
pdac_evidence: cDC2_CD1C present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Extended Data Fig. 1c-d: FCER1A, CD1C, CLEC10A)

label: DC3 (CD1C+ inflammatory DCs)
definition: CD1C+ dendritic cells that also express monocyte-like inflammatory genes (CD14, S100A8/9, VCAN); a DC subset distinct from both cDC2 and monocytes.
signature_ref: villani2017 (Fig. 1C: CD1C_B top genes S100A9, S100A8, VCAN, LYZ, ANXA1; text: CD14; DC identity genes CD1C, FCER1A, CLEC10A)
pdac_evidence: Not reported as a separate cluster in the PDAC studies used here (Cheng 2021 PAAD map; Caronni 2023)

label: Mature regulatory DCs (LAMP3+)
definition: Mature dendritic cells combining maturation (CCR7, CD40) and immunoregulatory (PD-L1, PD-L2, CD200) genes; arise from cDC1 and cDC2 after antigen uptake.
signature_ref: maier2020 (Fig. 4b); zilionis2019 (Fig. 4B: DC3)
pdac_evidence: LAMP3+ cDC present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); in human PDAC (Caronni 2023 Extended Data Fig. 1c-d: CCR7, CD200, CD274)

label: Plasmacytoid DCs
definition: Interferon-producing dendritic cells.
signature_ref: zilionis2019 (Fig. 4B); zhang2020 (Fig. S8B: hM02)
pdac_evidence: pDC_LILRA4 present in the pancreatic adenocarcinoma map of Cheng 2021 (Fig. S1C); no pDC cluster among the PDAC mononuclear phagocytes of Caronni 2023; in these data LILRA4 is detected in about 1% of cells of every myeloid lineage, so pDCs are probably not among the myeloid cells

label: AXL+SIGLEC6+ DCs (AS-DCs)
definition: Dendritic cells sharing features of pDCs and cDC2, marked by AXL and SIGLEC6.
signature_ref: villani2017 (Fig. 1C: DC5 top genes)
pdac_evidence: Not reported as a separate cluster in the PDAC studies used here

label: TAN-1 programme
definition: Pro-tumour, glycolytic neutrophil state described in PDAC.
signature_ref: wang2023 (Fig. 2D)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Wang 2023; BD Rhapsody platform)

label: TAN-2 programme
definition: Inflammation-associated neutrophil state described in PDAC.
signature_ref: wang2023 (Fig. 2D)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Wang 2023)

label: TAN-3 programme
definition: Transitional neutrophil state most similar to blood neutrophils.
signature_ref: wang2023 (Fig. 2D)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Wang 2023)

label: TAN-4 programme
definition: Interferon-stimulated neutrophil state.
signature_ref: wang2023 (Fig. 2D)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC (Wang 2023)

label: Fibroblasts
definition: Matrix-producing mesenchymal cells of the tumour stroma and of normal pancreas; in these data identified by DCN, COL1A1, LUM and PDPN (Loveless 2025). A fibroblast is defined by a combination of criteria (negative for epithelial, endothelial and immune markers, no tumour mutations), not by a single marker.
pdac_evidence: Fibroblasts of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3A: 66,192 cells from 200 samples, before quality filtering here)

label: Universal-like (PI16+) fibroblasts
definition: Fibroblasts resembling the PI16+ 'universal' fibroblasts found in every healthy tissue, thought to be progenitor-like and located around vessels (adventitia); in tumours they form the least activated, normal-like part of the stroma. A cross-tissue axis runs from these cells to TGF-beta-driven LRRC15+ myofibroblasts.
signature_ref: steele2025 (Results and Fig. 6d: F2 universal fibroblasts); korsunsky2022 (Fig. 2I: CD34+MFAP5+ C9); krishnamurty2022 (Fig. 1m: PI16, CD34 on the universal side of the human stromal axis)
pdac_evidence: PI16+ CAFs in human PDAC (Cumming 2025, Suppl. Fig. S5C); PI16+ FAP-low progenitor-like CAFs (DPT, CFD, PI16) around non-invaded nerves (Chen 2025, Fig. 3A, 4E); universal-like fibroblasts in tumour and adjacent normal pancreas (Buechler 2021 Fig. 4: human PDAC cluster c8, 3 patients); CD34, MFAP5 and TNXB mark the 'inflammatory' F2 cluster of chronic pancreatitis and PDAC (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3E-F)

label: Resident-like (C7+) fibroblasts
definition: Fibroblasts of the normal, resting pancreas that also persist in tumours: CXCL12, complement C7 and lipid-transport genes (APOD, APOE), without a contractile or a strong cytokine programme. They are the majority of fibroblasts in normal pancreas; complement-secreting CAFs of PDAC are probably the same cells (complement shown as a score), and iCAFs are thought to arise from them.
signature_ref: each gene reported in at least two independent human studies: dimitrieva2024 (Fig. 3E, normal fibroblasts F1: C7, CXCL12, PTGDS, SRPX, ADH1B); carpenter2023 (Fig. 5H, higher in donor than tumour fibroblasts: C7, APOD, APOE, GPX3, SRPX, LAMA2); chen2026 (Fig. 1E, csCAFs: C7, CXCL12, PTGDS, GPX3, APOE); gao2024 (Fig. S8, 4A: c03-COL15A1+ C7, CXCL12, APOD, APOE, PTGDS, LAMA2); buechler2021 (human cluster c8: C7, CXCL12, APOD); ADH1B also on the normal-like side of the human stromal axis (krishnamurty2022 Fig. 1m)
pdac_evidence: Normal fibroblasts F1 dominate normal pancreas and persist in pancreatitis and PDAC (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3B-E); donor-pancreas fibroblasts (6 donors) express these genes more than tumour fibroblasts, which gain ACTA2, FAP and LRRC15 and lose CXCL12 (Carpenter 2023 Fig. 3G-H, 5E-I); csCAFs about two-thirds of fibroblasts in normal pancreas and fewer in PDAC (Chen 2026 Fig. 1F); universal-like human cluster c8 in tumour and adjacent normal tissue (Buechler 2021 Fig. 4)
also_known_as: normal fibroblasts F1 (dimitrieva2024); complement-secreting CAFs, csCAF (chen2021, chen2026); c03-COL15A1+ (gao2024); human c8 (buechler2021); NF (tao2025)

label: Inflammatory and resident-like fibroblasts (iCAF family)
definition: Non-contractile fibroblasts: resident-like fibroblasts of the normal pancreas and the inflammatory CAFs (iCAFs) thought to arise from them, with cytokines, chemokines, complement and CXCL12 rather than contractile genes. In PDAC they sit farther from tumour glands, in the desmoplastic stroma. Sub-groups: resident-like (C7+) fibroblasts, inflammatory CAFs (iCAFs) and CCL19+ reticular-like fibroblasts.
signature_ref: union of the human iCAF signature of elyada2019 (Methods p. 18: IL6, PDGFRA, CFD, PLA2G2A, HAS1, CXCL2, CCL2, CLU, EMP1, LMNA) and the resident-like signature on this page (C7, CXCL12, APOD, APOE, PTGDS, GPX3, SRPX, LAMA2, ADH1B; sources on that card: dimitrieva2024, carpenter2023, chen2026, gao2024, buechler2021)
pdac_evidence: Human iCAF cluster in 6 untreated PDACs (Elyada 2019 Fig. 3); tumour-distal stroma with C3, C7, CXCL12, CFD (Croft 2023 Fig. 3-4, 24 patients); csCAFs and iCAFs farther from ducts than myCAFs, csCAF-to-iCAF transition inferred (Chen 2026 Fig. 4-5, 8A); normal fibroblasts to iCAFs inferred (Tao 2025 Fig. 5); iCAF-like cluster also in chronic pancreatitis (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3B-D)

label: Myofibroblastic fibroblasts (myCAF family)
definition: Contractile, matrix-producing fibroblasts driven by TGF-beta; in PDAC they lie next to tumour glands. ACTA2 alone is not specific (also mural cells, other CAFs).
signature_ref: elyada2019 (Methods p. 18: human myCAF signature; markers Fig. 3E)
pdac_evidence: Majority of human CAFs in tumour and adjacent normal samples (Elyada 2019 p. 7); tumour-proximal stroma with MMP11, HOPX (Croft 2023 Fig. 4E); myCAFs closest to epithelium (Chen 2026 Fig. 4D, 5K-N)

label: Nerve-associated (NGFR+) fibroblasts
definition: Fibroblasts inside or around nerves (endoneurial-like), expressing NGFR and axon-guidance genes; distinct from Schwann cells, which lack fibroblast genes.
signature_ref: chen2025 (Fig. 5A-D, Results: F07_Fibro-NRP2: NGFR, NRP2, AUTS2, RGMA); steele2025 (Fig. 6d: F5 NGFR+ fibroblasts: SCN7A, NGFR, EBF2, CLDN1)
pdac_evidence: Endoneurial fibroblast cluster localised inside nerves by spatial transcriptomics in 25 treatment-naive PDACs (Chen 2025 Fig. 5)

label: Mural-like cells (pericytes / smooth muscle)
definition: Cells with the pericyte / vascular smooth-muscle programme inside the fibroblast type. Mural cells and fibroblasts are separated by gene combinations, not single markers: ACTA2, TAGLN, MYL9 and PDGFRB occur in both. Cells labelled 'pancreatic stellate cells' in some PDAC studies (RGS5, NOTCH3, HIGD1B, NDUFA4L2) carry this programme.
signature_ref: muhl2020 (Fig. 1f: 45 mural-cell genes shared across four mouse organs; human orthologues, contractile genes shared with myofibroblasts left out); HIGD1B from chen2021 (Fig. 7G)
pdac_evidence: 'PSC' cluster RGS5, ADIRF, CRIP1, NDUFA4L2, NOTCH3 (Chen 2021 Fig. 3D); Du 2025 (Fig. 1C-D) notes RGS5 and PDGFRB are shared by stellate cells, pericytes and smooth muscle; pericytes are a separate cell type in these data

label: Mesothelial-like cells (WT1+)
definition: Cells with mesothelial genes. Mesothelial cells can turn into CAFs (antigen-presenting CAFs in mouse PDAC) and lose most mesothelial genes on the way, so this group marks mesothelium-like cells, not every mesothelium-derived CAF. MSLN and KRT19 are also tumour-cell genes whose RNA can carry over into fibroblast data; KRT19 is therefore left out.
signature_ref: huang2022 (Fig. 1H: Msln, Upk3b, Lrrn4, Krt19, mouse; human orthologues); WT1 from cumming2025 (Fig. 2A-B) and foster2022 (Fig. 4O)
pdac_evidence: WT1+ CAFs in human PDAC, confirmed by FAP/CRABP2 staining (Cumming 2025 Fig. 1H, 2A-B); pancreas-only WT1+ TWIST1+ CAF cluster (Foster 2022 Fig. 4O, 3 patients after neoadjuvant chemotherapy)

label: Schwann-like cells (not fibroblasts)
definition: Cells with Schwann-cell genes inside the fibroblast type. In PDAC data, Schwann cells have been mistaken for antigen-presenting CAFs because they express CD74 and HLA class II.
signature_ref: chen2025 (STAR Methods: SOX10, PLP1; Fig. 5H: MPZ); luo2022 (Fig. 4g: MPZ, S100B, LGI4, PLP1)
pdac_evidence: CD74+ HLA-DR+ cluster with GAP43, S100B in human PDAC fibroblasts = Schwann cells (Chen 2026 Fig. 1E); CD74 highest in Schwann cells (Oh 2023)

label: Complement programme (csCAF)
definition: Complement genes of complement-secreting CAFs (csCAFs), without the cytokines of iCAFs. csCAFs are the majority of fibroblasts in normal pancreas and are thought to be resident fibroblasts that persist in tumours; in one study more csCAFs went with longer survival.
signature_ref: chen2021 (Results and Fig. 3D: C3, C7, CFB, CFD, CFH, CFI); chen2026 (Fig. 1E, 8B: GPX3, OGN, PTGDS)
pdac_evidence: Human PDAC, 11 samples, stage I-III (Chen 2021 Fig. 3, 7); majority of fibroblasts in normal pancreas, fewer in PDAC; multiplex IHC with OS/RFS association; 13 published datasets (Chen 2026 Fig. 1F, 6-7); complement-high distal stroma in good-outcome patients (Croft 2023 Fig. 5)

label: Inflammatory CAFs (iCAFs)
definition: Cancer-associated fibroblasts with the inflammatory programme described in human PDAC: cytokines and chemokines (IL6, CXCL2, CCL2), hyaluronan synthase HAS1 and PDGFRA, rather than contractile genes. In PDAC they lie farther from tumour glands than myofibroblastic CAFs. They are thought to arise from resident-like fibroblasts (inferred from single-cell data, not traced).
signature_ref: elyada2019 (Methods p. 18: human iCAF signature, unchanged; markers Fig. 3D)
pdac_evidence: Human iCAF cluster in 6 untreated PDACs (Elyada 2019 Fig. 3D); iCAFs farther from ducts than myCAFs and next to macrophages (Chen 2026 Fig. 4D, 5K-N); 3-fold more iCAFs after chemotherapy (Zhou 2022 Fig. 7, 31 patients)

label: CCL19+ reticular-like fibroblasts
definition: Fibroblasts resembling the fibroblastic reticular cells of lymph nodes (CCL19, CCL21), found near tertiary lymphoid structures. CD74 and HLA class II genes, also typical of these cells, are left out of the signature because they come from immune cells as well.
signature_ref: steele2025 (Fig. 1c, 6d: F3 FRC-like fibroblasts); cords2023 (Table 1: rCAF CCL21, CCL19)
pdac_evidence: rCAFs enriched next to TLS in 8 treatment-naive PDACs (Kirschstein 2026 Fig. 7B-C, Visium); immunomodulatory CAF programme with CCL19, CCL21, CXCL12 (Hwang 2022 Fig. 4); rCAFs detected in PDAC data (Cords 2023 Fig. 3)

label: LRRC15+ myofibroblasts
definition: TGF-beta-programmed myofibroblasts at the activated end of the cross-tissue fibroblast axis; in mouse PDAC models they suppress CD8 T cells, and a high LRRC15+ CAF signature has been associated with poor response to anti-PD-L1.
signature_ref: dominguez2020 (Results p. 243 and Fig. 6E: 11-gene LRRC15+ CAF signature, the version used in the immunotherapy cohorts); same core in krishnamurty2022 (Fig. 1m) and gao2024 (Fig. 1E, S8: c04-LRRC15)
pdac_evidence: LRRC15/TAGLN-high cluster = 52% of 8,931 fibroblasts in 22 human PDACs; LRRC15 protein around, and excluded from, tumour islets in 70 patients (Dominguez 2020 Fig. 5D, 5G); PDAC high on the LRRC15/TGF-beta axis of sorted human stroma (Krishnamurty 2022 Fig. 1n); LRRC15+ CAFs cancer-specific (Cumming 2025 Fig. 2A-C); the 'CAF' cluster F5 (LRRC15, C1QTNF3, COL12A1, MMP11, COL11A1, GJB2) found only in malignant tissue, not in pancreatitis (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3E-F)
also_known_as: CAFs F5 (dimitrieva2024); TGF-beta CAFs (dominguez2020, krishnamurty2022); c04-LRRC15 (gao2024); F7 myofibroblasts (steele2025)

label: HOPX+ transitional myofibroblasts
definition: Myofibroblasts with high ACTA2 and TAGLN but little LRRC15 or CDH11, placed between normal fibroblasts and LRRC15+ CAFs by trajectory analysis (inferred, not traced). Found in PDAC and also in chronic pancreatitis.
signature_ref: dimitrieva2024 (Fig. 3E: transitional fibroblasts F4, read from the dot plot); gao2024 (Fig. 1E: c11-HOPX+ myofibroblasts HOPX, IGFBP5, TIMP1)
pdac_evidence: Transitional cluster F4, mainly in untreated and treated PDAC, intermediate on the trajectory to CAFs with rising MMP11 and POSTN (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3B-F, 4A-B; 19 patients); HOPX+ myofibroblasts as an intermediate state in a cross-tissue study including pancreas (Gao 2024 Fig. 1E, 3)

label: MMP1+ inflammatory myofibroblasts
definition: Myofibroblasts that also express inflammatory genes (MMP1, IL11, IL7R), found across inflamed and cancerous tissues and described as an intermediate state before LRRC15+ myofibroblasts. Evidence specific to PDAC is thin. CXCL8, part of some versions of this signature, is left out because tissue dissociation induces it.
signature_ref: steele2025 (Results; Fig. 3c, 6d: F6 core IL11, MMP1, IL7R; broader MMP3, INHBA); gao2024 (Fig. 1E: c19-MMP1 MMP1, COL7A1, WNT5A, IL7R; Fig. S8: IL11)
pdac_evidence: Cross-tissue study including 16,163 pancreas fibroblasts; MMP1+ signature enriched in immunotherapy non-responders (Gao 2024 Fig. 1B, 3F); minor IL11+ CAF population, not present in all 7 integrated PDAC studies (Oh 2023)
also_known_as: c19-MMP1 (gao2024); F6 inflammatory myofibroblasts (steele2025); IL11+ CAF (oh2023)

label: MHC-II antigen-presenting programme
definition: MHC class II genes in fibroblasts (antigen-presenting CAFs).
signature_ref: elyada2019 (Fig. 6A: human apCAF-associated genes; human apCAF-like cells were not a separate cluster)
pdac_evidence: HLA-DRA+CD74+ in 20.9% of human CAFs, admixed with iCAFs (Elyada 2019 Fig. 6B-C); PDGFRA+CD74+ cells correlate with Tregs in 33 patients (Huang 2022 Fig. 6D); no apCAF cluster in Loveless 2025, Oh 2023, Chen 2026, Cumming 2025; apCAF subclusters with T, B and mast-cell genes in Tao 2025 (Fig. 4A) suggest doublets

label: Hypoxia / tumour-like programme
definition: Hypoxia and glycolysis genes in fibroblasts (tumour-like CAFs, tCAFs); they reflect where a cell sits and are shared with other cell types nearby.
signature_ref: cords2023 (Table 1: tCAF MME, ENO1, NDRG1, CA9); chen2025 (Fig. 3A: F03_tCAF-MME with ENO1, VEGFA)
pdac_evidence: tCAF-MME enriched in PDACs with high neural invasion (Chen 2025 Fig. 3H); tCAFs detected in PDAC data (Cords 2023 Fig. 3); VEGFA-high iFb 3 in the original fibroblast clusters of these data (Loveless 2025 Fig. 3)

label: Dissociation-stress programme
definition: Immediate-early and heat-shock genes induced when tissue is digested with collagenase at 37 C. A high score suggests that a difference between cells may come from tissue handling.
signature_ref: oflanagan2019 (Fig. 3a: top 40 of the collagenase core signature; chemokines CXCL1-3, CXCL8 left out so the score stays separate from iCAFs)
pdac_evidence: Heat-shock/AP-1 genes higher in iCAFs of FOLFIRINOX-treated PDACs (Zhou 2022 Fig. 7g), which may mix treatment and handling effects

label: Neural-like CAF programme after chemotherapy
definition: Axon-guidance genes in CAFs, reported to increase after chemotherapy and to be richest near nerves invaded by tumour.
signature_ref: henstridge2025 (Results and Fig. 3: neural-CAF signature)
pdac_evidence: Higher after chemotherapy in matched biopsies of 5 patients; NEGR1+ CAFs most abundant near perineural invasion in 17 patients (Henstridge 2025 Fig. 3, 5; preprint)

label: Injury-reactive programme
definition: Stress- and injury-response genes in fibroblasts, increased in tumours after FOLFIRINOX-based neoadjuvant therapy and in autoimmune pancreatitis.
signature_ref: dimitrieva2024 (Fig. 3E: injury-reactive fibroblasts F3, read from the dot plot; DUSP1 left out as a dissociation-stress gene)
pdac_evidence: Cluster F3 larger in NAT-treated PDAC than in untreated PDAC; in pancreatitis mostly from one patient with autoimmune pancreatitis (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3B-D)

label: Interferon-response programme (ifCAF)
definition: Type I interferon-response genes in fibroblasts, including CXCL10 (interferon-response CAFs, ifCAFs). In human PDAC these cells score high on myCAF genes; in mouse models, STING agonists induce them and they restrain tumours.
signature_ref: cumming2025 (Fig. 2G: RSAD2, IFIT3, CXCL10, DDX58); tao2025 (Fig. 2B-C: ISG15, IFIT1 in ISG+ myCAFs)
pdac_evidence: ifCAF cluster in 6 human PDACs, IFIT3/RSAD2+ CAFs by in situ hybridisation in 3 patients (Cumming 2025 Fig. 2G, 2J); ISG+ myCAFs (Tao 2025, 1.4% of CAFs); the CXCL10+ myFb 5 of Loveless 2025 lies next to basal-like tumour cells (Loveless 2025 Fig. 4-5)
also_known_as: ifCAF (cumming2025); ISG+ myCAF (tao2025); ifnCAF (cords2023); CXCL10+ myFb 5 (loveless2025)

label: Metallothionein programme
definition: Metallothionein genes in fibroblasts, reported higher in iCAFs after gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel.
signature_ref: zhou2022 (Fig. 7f)
pdac_evidence: Higher in iCAFs of gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel-treated PDACs (Zhou 2022 Fig. 7f, 31 patients); MT2A in the injury-reactive fibroblasts that increase after FOLFIRINOX-based therapy (Dimitrieva 2024 Fig. 3E)
